item: The brand holds a state tasting permit for the period.
Our tasting staff need no permit of their own; the brand's permit covers them.
The store holds its own tasting permit.
Each server carries a state identification card.
No advance notice of the event is filed with the division.
Each sample stays within the size limit.
The store owner's written consent is on file.
A log of each tasting is kept.
A certificate of insurance is filed with the division.
A brand representative is present at every tasting.
Every taster's age is verified before service.
The municipality's ordinance is reviewed for each store.
No signage need be posted at the tasting table.
A separate permit is obtained for each store.
No report is filed after the event.
